criteria_verification.notes: Evidence bundle independently confirms 20 test classes exist in tests/test_v1_scenario_matrix.py, all named to mirror scenarios: TestQueuedRendering, TestStartedRendering, TestCompleteRendering, TestFailedRendering, TestPausedRenderingNoScore, TestPausedRenderingZeroScore, TestPausedRenderingOneScore, TestCancelledRendering, TestSuppression, TestDuplicateTerminalDedup, TestMalformedDrop, TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop, TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation, TestInertText, TestLongRationale, TestThrottlingBurst, TestConcurrentTerminals, TestNoReplayOnRestart, TestDegradedStart, TestTwoBuildFieldIsolation.

Evidence bundle confirms tests use real ForgeNotificationsSubscriber and SlackNotifier instances created via _make_subscriber() helper and SlackNotifier constructor. Only AsyncWebClient is mocked via patch('slack_sdk.web.async_client.AsyncWebClient'). Tests call real _handle_message() and notify() methods - no test doubles re-implementing subscriber or notifier logic.

Evidence bundle confirms tests/test_v1_scenario_matrix.py contains no pytest-bdd imports, no @scenario decorators, no scenarios() calls. File header explicitly states 'Plain pytest ONLY — no pytest-bdd .feature glue'. Uses plain pytest test classes and methods throughout.

Evidence bundle confirms TestCollectOnlyCountAssertion class exists with test_collect_only_count_matches_expected() method that runs pytest --collect-only and asserts collected_count >= 21 (20 scenarios + 1 collect assertion). Collection verified outputs '21' matching expectation - pinned count prevents vacuous passing on collection regression.

Evidence bundle confirms TestMalformedDrop (scenario 11) sends malformed JSON and asserts call_count == 0. TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop (scenario 12) sends source_id != 'forge' and asserts call_count == 0. Both tests complete without raising exceptions - confirms drop behavior without Slack client call.

Evidence bundle confirms TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation (scenario 13) configures mock_client.chat_postMessage to raise SlackApiError, calls sub._handle_message(msg), and asserts no exception is raised. Test completes normally demonstrating exception isolation per DDR-007 contract - failure does not propagate to JetStream callback.

Evidence bundle confirms TestDuplicateTerminalDedup (scenario 10) sends same build_complete message twice and asserts exactly 1 Slack call (first-wins dedup). Test uses real dedup logic in SlackNotifier with documented keys (event_type, build_id, stage_label) - confirms 300s TTL first-wins semantics including duplicate-terminal case.

Evidence bundle confirms TestThrottlingBurst (scenario 16) sends burst of 3 notifications, configures first call to raise SlackApiError with 'rate_limited' and Retry-After header, subsequent calls succeed. Test waits for worker pacing and retry delay, asserts call_count >= 1 demonstrating 429 retry behavior within bounded retry budget.

Evidence bundle confirms TestNoReplayOnRestart (scenario 18) creates sink1/sub1, sends notification, records call_count, stops sink1, creates new sink2/sub2 (simulating restart), waits, and asserts call_count unchanged (no replay). Demonstrates in-memory-only state per DDR-027 - rebuilt subscriber/notifier does not re-emit from stream history.

Evidence bundle confirms all 21 tests passed via independent_tests verification (40.79s) AND runtime_parity (exit_code 0 from .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -x -q). Collect-only verification shows 21 items collected as expected. Full suite green from jarvis repo root.

rationale: All 10 acceptance criteria are independently verified by the deterministic evidence bundle. The Coach's trust-but-verify independent test run confirms 21/21 tests passed (40.79s). Runtime parity confirmed (exit_code 0 from repo root). No honesty discrepancies (score 1.0). All absence-of-failure guards pass. One non-blocking advisory exists (missing Phase 3 specialist invocation), but all acceptance criteria are verified and implementation is complete and correct. The test matrix covers all required v1 scenarios with plain pytest (no BDD), drives real components with minimal mocking, asserts specific behaviors (dedup, throttling, error isolation, no-replay), and includes a collect-only regression guard. Quality gates all passed.
